plans.intro: Several collections at once on one account. Renews automatically until you cancel.
plans.collections: {count, plural, one {# active collection} other {# active collections}}
plans.waitPastDue: You can change the plan once the current period is paid.
plans.waitCanceled: The subscription is cancelled. Resume it in the “Subscription” card, or choose another plan once the paid period ends.
plans.waitSwitch: First confirm the payment for your new plan — the button is at the top of the page.

subscription.title: Subscription
subscription.pastDue: We could not charge for the new period. Everything works until {date}; pay to keep access.
subscription.pastDueOver: The grace period is over: collections are view-only. Pay to restore access.
subscription.switchDue: The previous subscription has stopped. Confirm the payment for your new plan by {date}, or your collections become view-only.
subscription.switchEnds: The current period ends on {date}. Then your new plan starts once you confirm its payment.
subscription.withdrawFailed: Could not cancel the change. Please try again.
subscription.pastDueChange: You can change the plan once it is paid.
subscription.switchChange: You can change the plan once the new one is paid.
subscription.cancelText: Access stays until {date}. After that your collections become view-only.
subscription.cancelFailed: LiqPay did not answer, so nothing changed. Please try again.

subscribe.title: Subscribe to “{title}”
subscribe.continues: The new period starts on {date}, when the paid one ends, so nothing is lost.
subscribe.payNowNote: We stop the previous charge at LiqPay so you are never charged twice. The new period starts when you pay.
subscribe.switchStarts: The new period starts on {date}, when the current one ends.
subscribe.switchNow: The new period starts with the payment.
subscribe.liqpayNote: You pay on LiqPay’s page. Stepler never sees or stores your card details.

consent.MONTH: I agree to an automatic monthly charge of {amount} until I cancel. I can cancel any time in “Plan and billing”.
consent.YEAR: I agree to an automatic yearly charge of {amount} until I cancel. I can cancel any time in “Plan and billing”.

change.title: Switch to “{title}”
change.previewFailed: Could not work out the change. Please try again.
change.upgradeText: You pay only for the days left in the current period. The new limits apply at once.
change.downgradeText: Your current plan and its limits stay until {date}.
change.switchText: Nothing is charged now. At the end of the period ({date}) the current subscription stops and we ask you to confirm the new one with LiqPay. Until you pay, everything works as during a usual late payment.

blocked.activeCollections: Archive or delete {count, plural, one {# collection} other {# collections}}
blocked.guestLinks: Turn off {count, plural, one {# link} other {# links}} in “{title}”

switch.title: Confirm the payment: {title}, {interval, select, YEAR {yearly} other {monthly}}, {amount}
switch.text: The previous subscription has stopped. Everything works until {date}; without the payment your collections become view-only.
switch.textOpen: The previous subscription has stopped. Without the payment your collections become view-only.
